name: mm-core
description: Engine-agnostic MonkeyMode: the design-to-ship game dev workflow (brief, GDD, narrative, UX, architecture, epics, stories, dev, review, playtest, retrospective), agent operating docs, guardrails with an after-edit hook, and the mm-setup onboarding.

coding_level.title: Coding level
coding_level.description: Can you read code? MonkeyMode adapts how agents verify their work and explain it. People who do not read code always get strict guardrails.

uses_chatgpt.title: Do you also use ChatGPT?
uses_chatgpt.description: For images we recommend ChatGPT. With yes, concept-art skills write ready-to-paste ChatGPT prompts; with no they suggest other routes.
